asset_type.description: `library` and/or `element`. Leaving this out of the request will get both by default, though element-only parameters like `library_id` or `archived` will isolate the result to elements.

library_id.description: Library ID (URN) to constrain an elements search to a single library (like "urn:aaid:sc:us:2f3268e9-039d-460f-8b07-8854f7677645"). Invalid if submitted with `"asset_type": ["library"]`.

group.description: Isolate element results to a single group. Invalid if submitted with `"asset_type": ["library"]`.

name.description: A name string to identify by library/asset name. Requires an exact match.

query_string.description: A general query string to search for libraries/assets. Includes partial matches.

created_date.description: Start & end dates in epoch time (ms since epoch).

modified_date.description: Start & end dates in epoch time (ms since epoch).

type.description: One or more types for elements, invalid if submitted with `"asset_type": ["library"]`.

archived.description: Search specifically for archived elements (boolean `true`/`false` to isolate results to archived or non-archived). Invalid if submitted with `"asset_type": ["library"]`.

orderBy.description: defaults to `-modified_date`, also accepts `name`. Use a minus sign prefix to note descending.

start.description: String value. For libraries lists, the requirement to integrate bookmarked responses requires us to use the field in a clever fashion beyond a simple positive integer.

limit.description: Positive integer, defines the number of results to return for a paged response. Defaults to `10`. Max limit for library searches is `10`, max limit for element searches is `100`.

owner.description: `private` (default), `incoming`, `outgoing`, `public`, or `all`. `all` does not include `public` until bookmarks are integrated into the USS search results.

selector.description: Customize response for larger/smaller data sets. (`default` [base response], `rendition_grid`, `collaboration`, `details`, `full`).

has_stock_content.description: Search for libraries that have stock content, or elements within a library that have stock content (boolean `true`/`false` to isolate results to stock content or all content).

stock_content_id.description: Search for elements with a specific Stock Content ID. Invalid if submitted with `"asset_type": ["library"]` or `"has_stock_content": false`.

spark_brand_urn.description: Search for elements with a specific Spark tracking data brand_urn.

spark_creator_id.description: Search for elements with a specific Spark tracking data creator_id.

spark_content_summary.description: Search for elements with a partial match within the Spark tracking data content_summary.

source_ref.description: Search for elements with a specific sourceRef.
